settings.heading: Their favourite memory, glowing in glass.
settings.text: A glass orb with a small screen inside that plays the video you choose. A gift for the moment you never want them to forget.

settings.text: The first dance, the first steps, the trip you still talk about. Pick the clip and it plays inside the glass.

settings.text: A 2.8-inch colour screen sits behind the glass, so the picture seems to float inside it.

settings.heading: Room for more than one memory
